replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, often. Abstract algebra and complex equations make me nervous because they're not intuitive for me. My high neuroticism makes this worse, but I manage by focusing on practical applications like physics.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using AI a couple of times to explain physics problems. It helped, but I found it frustrating when it gave answers without step-by-step reasoning, which my moderate conscientiousness craves.
